title: Nutty Aerated American Custard Frittata
description: A nutty, aerated brunch dish featuring custard powder and an encroute style crust

ingredients.name: grated ghee-roasted almonds
ingredients.notes: add some nutty flavor and crunch

instructions: Preheat a non-stick tava or griddle over medium heat, brushing with a little butter.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, custard powder, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
In a separate pan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add grated almonds and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes, then set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together flour and a pinch of salt, and gradually add in a little water to form a crumbly dough.
Knead dough until smooth and pliable, then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Dust the tava or griddle with a little flour, and roll out the dough to fit the pan.
Fry the dough in a little butter until golden and crispy, then flip and cook the other side.
Add the egg mixture to the pan, and sprinkle with cheese.
Allow the eggs to set at the edges, then sprinkle with the reserved almond mixture.
Transfer the frittata to the preheated tava or griddle, and cook until the bottom is golden and crispy.
Fold the frittata in half, and cook for an additional minute, until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
Slide the frittata out of the pan onto a plate, and garnish with additional almonds if desired.
